class.name: SentryAutoMetricsOptions
class.description: Configures performance metrics collected automatically by the SDK. Access these options through [member SentryOptions.auto_metrics] or Project Settings under [b]Sentry > Auto Metrics[/b]. Automatic collection is disabled by default and does not affect metrics sent manually through [member SentrySDK.metrics]. Attributes added to automatic metrics include [code]gpu.name[/code], [code]cpu.cores[/code], [code]ram.gb[/code], [code]res.x[/code], [code]res.y[/code], and [code]scene[/code] when available. Resolution describes the root viewport's target size in pixels, before window stretching and after 3D scaling. [codeblock] SentrySDK.init(func(options: SentryOptions) -> void: options.auto_metrics.enable_frame_metrics = true options.auto_metrics.frame_metrics_interval_sec = 2.0 ) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Collection pauses while the application is unfocused or paused by the operating system. [member SceneTree.paused] and [member Engine.time_scale] do not affect collection. To learn more, visit [url=https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/godot/metrics/]Metrics documentation[/url].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], sends [code]game.perf.frame_time[/code] as a distribution in milliseconds and [code]game.perf.fps[/code] as a gauge. Frame time measures elapsed time between process callbacks, including VSync and frame limiting. The collector randomly samples one frame per [member frame_metrics_interval_sec] interval. As more clients send frame samples, aggregate percentiles become more reliable, though sampling can miss rare hitches.

If [code]true[/code], sends the following metrics: [code]game.perf.used_memory[/code]: Memory (RAM) used by the game, in bytes. [code]game.perf.object_count[/code]: Number of instantiated objects, including nodes. See [constant Performance.OBJECT_COUNT]. [code]game.perf.node_count[/code]: Number of nodes in the scene tree, including its root. See [constant Performance.OBJECT_NODE_COUNT]. [b]Platform support:[/b] Memory usage is collected on Windows, Linux, Android, macOS, and iOS. Skipped on other platforms.

If [code]true[/code], sends the following network gauges using the default [SceneTree] multiplayer API: [code]game.perf.net.num_peers[/code]: Connected remote peers, excluding this instance. Servers and mesh peers only. [code]game.perf.net.ping[/code]: Client's round-trip time to the server, in milliseconds. [code]game.perf.net.ping_peer_avg[/code], [code]game.perf.net.ping_peer_max[/code]: Average and highest peer round-trip times, in milliseconds. Servers and mesh peers only. [code]game.perf.net.in_rate[/code], [code]game.perf.net.out_rate[/code]: Bytes received and sent per second, including ENet protocol traffic and retransmissions. [code]game.perf.net.in_packets[/code], [code]game.perf.net.out_packets[/code]: UDP datagrams received and sent per second, rather than RPC or game-message counts. [b]Backend support:[/b] Peer counts are supported with all transports. Ping and traffic rates are supported only with ENet. [b]Note:[/b] Ping includes Godot's network-processing delays. It describes the latency the game experiences, but cannot isolate network delay from processing delay. [b]Note:[/b] Traffic collection resets ENet's shared byte and packet counters. Other code reading those counters affects these measurements, and vice versa.

If [code]true[/code], sends the following gauges from [Performance]: [code]game.perf.render.draw_calls[/code]: Draw calls in the last rendered frame. See [constant Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME]. [code]game.perf.render.primitives[/code]: Vertices or indices rendered in the last frame, including depth and shadow passes. See [constant Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_PRIMITIVES_IN_FRAME]. [code]game.perf.render.video_mem_used[/code]: Total video memory used, including texture, buffer, and other allocations, in bytes. See [constant Performance.RENDER_VIDEO_MEM_USED]. [code]game.perf.render.texture_mem_used[/code]: Texture memory used, in bytes. See [constant Performance.RENDER_TEXTURE_MEM_USED]. [code]game.perf.render.buffer_mem_used[/code]: Render buffer memory used, in bytes. See [constant Performance.RENDER_BUFFER_MEM_USED].
Interval between frame metric collections, in seconds. Used only when [member enable_frame_metrics] is [code]true[/code].
Interval between memory metric collections, in seconds. Used only when [member enable_memory_metrics] is [code]true[/code].
Interval between network metric collections, in seconds. Used only when [member enable_network_metrics] is [code]true[/code].
Interval between rendering metric collections, in seconds. Used only when [member enable_rendering_metrics] is [code]true[/code].
